content.test_md_blob:
# Home page publishing CTAs route visitors to the publishing packages page

> Prove that each home-page publishing call to action that promises the publishing packages page takes the visitor to `/publish`.

## Step 1

Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-44

On the Fernwood Press home page hero area, activate the `Start Publishing` call to action, then assert the browser URL path equals `/publish`.

## Step 3

Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser again and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-46

On the Fernwood Press home page, activate `Compare all packages →`, then assert the browser URL path equals `/publish`.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: absolute
      operand: /publish
      operator: equals
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-44
    objective: On the Fernwood Press home page hero area, activate the `Start Publishing` call to action, then assert the browser URL path equals `/publish`.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-44
  - objective: Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser again and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.
    step: 3
  - objective: On the Fernwood Press home page, activate `Compare all packages →`, then assert the browser URL path equals `/publish`.
    step: 4
    verifies:
      - ac-46
scenario: Use the publishing CTAs on the home page to reach the packages page
title: Home page publishing CTAs route visitors to the publishing packages page

content.title: Home page shows the promised discovery content and section counts
content.test_md_blob:
# Home page shows the promised discovery content and section counts

> Prove that the home page presents the discovery content promised to a first-time visitor: the heading, the catalog-size statement, four package previews with their required metadata, and four recently published book tiles.

## Step 1

Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-55, ac-54

In the home page hero area, inspect the main heading and catalog-size statement, then assert the heading reads `Publish your book with Fernwood Press` and the page shows text matching `<count>+ books published through our platform`.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-48

In the `Choose a publishing package` section, count the package previews, then assert exactly four package previews are shown.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-49, ac-50, ac-45, ac-51

In the same `Choose a publishing package` section, inspect every package preview, then assert each preview shows a visible package name, tagline, price, and `View package` link.

## Step 5 @verifies ac-52

In the `Recently published` section, count the displayed book tiles, then assert exactly four book tiles are shown.

objectives:

    step: 2

      - ac-55
      - ac-54
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored

  - objective: In the `Recently published` section, count the displayed book tiles, then assert exactly four book tiles are shown.
    step: 5

      - ac-52
scenario: Review the home page discovery content and section counts
title: Home page shows the promised discovery content and section counts

content.test_md_blob:
# Home page catalog CTA routes visitors to the published books catalog

> Prove that the home-page CTA for browsing all published books takes the visitor to `/books`.

## Step 1

Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-47

On the Fernwood Press home page, activate `Browse all published books →`, then assert the browser URL path equals `/books`.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{home_page_url}} in the browser and wait for the Fernwood Press home page to load.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: absolute
      operand: /books
      operator: equals
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-47
    objective: On the Fernwood Press home page, activate `Browse all published books →`, then assert the browser URL path equals `/books`.
    step: 2

scenario: Use the catalog CTA on the home page to reach the published books catalog
title: Home page catalog CTA routes visitors to the published books catalog

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Kept first in the tests budget because both publishing CTAs are public author-conversion routes and a failure there blocks the primary publishing path from the landing page.

[value_score] Kept second because this single content-review test proves most of the static public promises on the home page, including the commercial package-preview metadata and exact section counts.
[value_score] Kept third because the catalog CTA is a named public route from the home page, though narrower than the publishing-route and broad content-review coverage.

[self_critique] Oracle-proves-promise: each asserted URL-path check directly proves its corresponding route AC without depending on unrelated page content. Technique fit: a happy-path browser navigation test matches the scenario's equivalent CTA routing intent. Negative coverage was not added because REQ-02 states no failing or invalid-input branch for these CTAs. Over-broad assertions were avoided by asserting only the promised destination path after each activation.

[self_critique] Oracle-proves-promise: the test uses direct visible-text and exact-count assertions for the heading, catalog-size statement, package-preview count, required package-preview fields, and recent-books count. Technique fit: static content inspection on the public home page matches the scenario better than route navigation or boundary analysis. No negative case was added because the source defines no invalid state or alternate error behavior for the home page itself. Over-broad assertions were reduced by separating section counts from per-preview metadata checks.

[self_critique] Oracle-proves-promise: the asserted `/books` destination path directly proves the catalog-route AC. Technique fit: a single happy-path browser navigation step matches the scenario's narrow routing objective. Negative coverage was not added because REQ-02 states no error branch for this CTA. Over-broad assertions were avoided by checking only the promised route outcome, not unrelated catalog-page content.
